sections.text_helper: Section 49.8.20 "CRYP initialization vector register 1R (CRYP_IV1RR)" in chapter 49 (Cryptographic processor (CRYP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2405.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x4C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 IVI[31:0]: Initialization vector bit x (x= 31 to 0)
This bitfield stores the initialization vector bits [31:0] for AES chaining modes other than ECB.
The value stored in CRYP_IVxR/LR registers is updated by hardware after each computation
round (when applicable).
Write to this register is ignored when CRYP is busy (BUSY bit set).
